content: The goal should be to ensure the provision of drinking water that is entirely free of fecal indicator organisms, such as Escherichia coli. The objective must be to consistently supply drinking water that contains no fecal indicator organisms, including Escherichia coli. Delete: Available data inadequate to permit derivation of health-based guideline value. 3 mg/L has been proposed. Insert: Available data inadequate to permit derivation of health-based guideline value. 0.3 mg/L has been proposed. 0.7 [mg/L] 70 [µg/L]. These corrections have been incorporated into the electronic file.
